brief:
Britons are increasingly risking personal consequences—including legal jeopardy and damage to their reputations—to support Palestinians and challenge their government's policies on Gaza, Al Jazeera English reported. The scale of Israel's military operations in the territory has mobilized a new wave of activism across the United Kingdom.

The movement reflects growing public concern over the humanitarian toll of the conflict and represents a shift in how some British citizens are engaging with Middle East politics. Activists have taken steps ranging from public demonstrations to direct action, despite potential repercussions from authorities and employers.
dek: Britons are risking freedom and reputations to stand with Palestinians and challenge government policy.
title: Gaza war draws British activists into Palestinian solidarity movement
